# Announcing Public Preview for Azure Cosmos DB in Fabric Database Hub!

## What Changed

Azure Cosmos DB support in Fabric Database Hub is now available in public preview. For the first time, Azure Cosmos DB customers can discover and monitor their accounts from Database Hub alongside other Microsoft database engines.
